newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV sees '96 result above '95 record.
newsitem.headline: OMV sees '96 result above '95 record.

text.p: Austrian energy and chemicals group OMV said on Friday it expected full-year earnings to top last year's record results.
"The 1996 earnings will be above the record result of 1995," finance chief Wolfgang Ruttensdorfer said at an invesment fair. An expected slump in polyolefin prices had not materialised, he added.
OMV, Austria's biggest industrial company, last year reported net earnings of 1.73 billion schillings and a pre-tax profit of 2.1 billion on sales of 92 billion schillings.

Last month, the group warned that a downturn in polyolefin prices and increased pressure on refining margins was likely to put a damper on second-half earnings and should keep full-year results "in line" with last year's. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
